key_insight: Policy-coupled coverage makes uncertainty quantification decision-aware, enabling counterfactual prediction sets that are both valid and utility-optimal.
engineering_relevance: For high-stakes decision systems, this provides a principled way to couple predictive uncertainty with action selection so the chosen policy remains reliable and more profitable under uncertainty.
method: Define policy-coupled coverage: the realized outcome under the action induced by the prediction set must be covered.
Derive a max-min decision rule that is minimax-optimal under distributional ambiguity.
Introduce PC-RACP, a two-stage conformal method that approximates the optimal sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees.
evidence_signal: The approach is evaluated in simulations and a real email-marketing experiment, where it achieves higher utility than existing methods while maintaining valid coverage.
watch_item: The method depends on accurate modeling of the counterfactual decision structure, so misspecification of the action-outcome relationship could reduce its practical benefit.
paper_title: Prediction Sets for Counterfactual Decisions: Coverage, Optimality, and Conformal Prediction
